message: declares no selector, so no consumer names it
$reason: ngc compiles `selector: ''` as it compiles no selector at all, under its default `ng-component` (`resolved === "" ? defaultSelector`, measured through ngc 22.2.1), so an empty one is no selector to point 3 either. Its button names nothing of its own: refused for that, and not for the inputs a component under a selector of its own is asked for.
